entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm a bit lost. I bought some cycling shoes a while ago and I... I think I need to send them back. The website was so confusing, I didn't know what to do.
I can certainly help you look into that. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

I guess it's a fit issue? I just can't get them to feel right. No matter how I position the cleats, I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. I'm just so overwhelmed by it all. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Of course, I can help you. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment, please.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the cycling shoes were delivered to you 64 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I wasn't sure what the rule was.
Not at all. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can get a refund? What do I need to do?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you a prepaid shipping label to your email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office.
Wow, that's so easy. Thank you so much, Isaac! You've been a huge help.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day, and we hope to help you find a more comfortable pair of shoes soon. Goodbye.
